title: 1812 Prairie's carved stone, from the Levy photograph
items: Over 1812 Prairie's second-storey north window, the carved frieze and the band of sunk panels from Albert Levy's photograph now run from the south projection to the corner, between the print's moulded band and ledge
The projection's arched and paired windows stand in quoined stone jambs, with a band at the arched window's spring and two carved bosses under the upper window's jambs
